content.title: 8-2-3-16. Effect of denial; successive applications.
content.summary: A.	Generally. It is the policy of the City not to allow successive applications for the same development approval after an application is denied.

faqs.a:
A.	Generally. It is the policy of the City not to allow successive applications for the same development approval after an application is denied. The provisions of this Section as intended to limit the consideration of successive applications.
B.	Minimum Interval between Submittal of Substantially Similar Applications. If an application is denied, the City shall not accept any application that is substantially similar to the denied application as determined by the Director for a period of 12 months, unless:
  1.	After the application is denied, the City amends the applicable provisions in this LDC in a manner that could reasonably allow for approval of the application; or
  2.	The City Council waives the minimum interval requirement of this Section for good cause shown; or
  3.	The denied application is for a sign permit, Wireless Communication Facility, or Small Cell facility.
